name: Grimbooze Thunderbrew
summary: Grimbooze Thunderbrew is an eccentric dwarven brewmaster camped out in the Dagger Hills of Westfall. Renowned across Dun Morogh as one of the founders of the great dwarven brewing traditions, he currently spends his days concocting potent spirits and speaking almost entirely in verse.

sections.title: A Brewer in Exile
sections.body: Hailing from the renowned Thunderbrew brewing dynasty of Kharanos, Grimbooze once oversaw the Thunderbrew Distillery in Dun Morogh. Known for his jovial disposition and an unyielding passion for potent spirits, Grimbooze left the snowy mountain peaks for the windswept hills of Westfall. His relatives quietly attribute his wanderlust—and his bizarre habit of speaking strictly in rhymes—to consuming far too much legendary drink over the years. Travelers passing through the dangerous Dagger Hills can find him tending to his private casks, always eager to test a thirsty traveler's palate.

sections.title: The Contest of Brews
sections.body: Before settling in Westfall, Grimbooze played a pivotal role in brewing history. Years ago, the distillery welcomed an enigmatic wandering pandaren brewmaster named Chen Stormstout. The two engaged in an epic drinking bout, matching Grimbooze's finest recipes against Chen's enchanted Jug of a Thousand Cups. Unable to agree on whose craft reigned supreme, they arranged a massive public tasting contest in Dun Morogh—an event that laid the groundwork for modern dwarven drinking festivals. While his kin manage the distillery back in Kharanos, Grimbooze remains out in the field, refining his family's signature ale.

faq.q: Where can I find Grimbooze Thunderbrew?
faq.answer: Grimbooze Thunderbrew is stationed in the Dagger Hills, situated in southern Westfall, keeping camp amidst the hills with his brewing equipment.

faq.q: Why is Grimbooze speaking in rhymes?
aliases: why is he talking in verse
faq.answer: His eccentric rhyming speech is an idiosyncrasy developed after decades of sampling incredibly potent spirits, notably Chen Stormstout's enchanted brew, which his family claims slightly pickled his mind.

faq.q: What is his connection to the Thunderbrew Distillery?
faq.answer: Grimbooze is a patriarch of the famous Thunderbrew clan of Kharanos in Dun Morogh. He once ran the Thunderbrew Distillery before heading out into the wider world, leaving family members like Ragnar Thunderbrew to manage operations at home.

faq.q: Did Grimbooze really drink with a pandaren?
faq.answer: Yes. Grimbooze hosted the wandering brewmaster Chen Stormstout in Kharanos. Their spirited contest to see who brewed the finest ale led directly to a legendary tasting competition in the snow of Dun Morogh.

angles.text: Every dwarf knows the Thunderbrew name, and finding one of their foremost elders brewing wild recipes in the Westfall hills is a welcome taste of Dun Morogh.
Culinary adventurers and spirit crafters revere the Thunderbrew legacy, making an encounter with Grimbooze a lesson in artisanal brewing.
